services.value: Full-service environmental testing laboratory providing analytical services including PFAS testing (EPA 537.1, LC/MS/MS with NELAP/ORELAP accreditation), asbestos, legionella, water quality, radon, mold, lead surface testing, chain of custody forms, plant screening, fungi testing, kratom testing, and air quality testing (mold spores and asbestos particles). They also offer licensed field technician sample collection, and custom research & development testing services.
